WHERE 
    -- Calculate age exactly at the time of the order (o.date)
    -- Age is completed years: anniversary of birth <= order date < next anniversary
    -- We check if the customer turned 25 on or before the order date, and has not yet turned 26
    -- This is equivalent to: order date is between 25th birthday (inclusive) and 26th birthday (exclusive)
    -- Using string comparison since dates are in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'
    -- 25th birthday: birth_date + 25 years
    -- 26th birthday: birth_date + 26 years
    -- We need: (birth_date + 25 years) <= o.date < (birth_date + 26 years)
    -- Since we're dealing with text dates, we can use date() function for proper date arithmetic
    date(o.date) >= date(c.birth_date, '+25 years')
